messages:
Maya: Quick thread to lock the MVP canary for Optimize toolkit (batching + KV prefix cache + quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). Goal: safe savings without regressions; plan: discovery -> canary (2 weeks) -> scale.
Jordan: Callout: separate "must-pass" safety gates from "benefit" goals. Safety gates block promotion.
Priya: Customers asked for clear opt-in and reporting. We'll require consent and a concise explainer for pilot customers.
Sanjay: Runtime preference: enable features on Dedicated first. Need per-tenant safe-mode and per-route toggles. Also KV invalidation API (TTL + explicit).
Lee: Ops telemetry contract (minimum): batch_start/batch_end events, cache_hit/cache_miss, quant_variant_served, eval_alert. Metrics: p50/p95 latency per route, token_cost_per_op, cache_hit_rate, eval_concordance_pct, customer_error_rate. Tag dims: customer_id, route, model_variant.
Alex: Draft safety gates: eval_concordance delta <= 2% abs; customer_error_rate delta <= 0.3%; no P1 incidents from caching/batching for canary window. Benefit goals: token_cost_per_op improvement >= 10%; median latency not worse for low-latency routes. Promote if safety passes + >=1 benefit.
Priya: Customer tranche: 5 opt-in customers across tiers. Consent window and legal sign-off required.
Sanjay: Config sketch for canary:
```noptimize_toolkit:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_ms: 12
    max_batch_size: 64
  cache:
    enabled: true
    kv_prefix_ttl_s: 300
    explicit_invalidate: true
  quant_recs:
    suggest_only: true
    levels: [int8, int8-fp16-hybrid]
  eval_alerts:
    enabled: true
    severity_map:
      regression: P2
      discordant: P3
```
Lee: Rollback policy: auto-rollback if eval_alert severity >= P2 or customer_error_rate > 0.5% for 5 minutes. Ops will implement circuit and runbook. Retain eval traces 30 days.
Jordan: Eval cadence: nightly diff runs (candidate vs baseline) on canonical prompts. Alert if N-of-M failures or concordance delta exceeds threshold; include diffs in alert. Alex to own initial eval runs.
Alex: I'll run weekly reports and add a small pipeline job to compare int8 vs fp16 on canonical prompts and attach examples.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-10-05T09:00Z -> slot canary-3001 created.
Maya: Next steps: Priya to coordinate customer outreach and consent, Alex to own eval jobs, Sanjay to add safe-mode API + invalidation, Lee to implement rollback/runbook, Jordan to wire dashboards. Reconvene next Tue after discovery.
Priya: Adding backlog items to pilot doc: consent template, canonical prompts v1, safe-mode API spec, dashboard wireframes, eval job config.
All: 7
Maya: Thanks, team. I'll update the pilot doc and tag owners. :rocket:
